name: Vehicle Management System API
description:
This API specification defines the contract for a Vehicle Management System
(Parking Guidance System) designed for mid-to-large commercial buildings.

The API surface is intentionally split into:
1. Vendor-owned, read-only data APIs (sensor occupancy and device health)
2. Product-owned decision APIs (vehicle verification, parking allocation, lifecycle management)

This document is intended for:
- Product review
- Engineering alignment
- Vendor integration planning
- API contract documentation

⚠️ IMPORTANT
These are just dummy apis and won't work, it's only for information purspose.
